title: BPTF-665aa mediate chromatin remodeling drives chemoresistance in T-LBL/ALL.
authors: Chen, Rong-Hui; Li, Mei; Zhou, Zhen-Zhong; Fang, Xiao-Jie; Zhu, Yong; Zhang, Yuan; Liu, Xu; Li, Hai-Long; Feng, Jing; Song, Li-Yan; Yu, Rong-Min; Gao, Tian-Xiao; Tian, Xiao-Peng; Huang, Wei-Juan
journal: Journal of experimental & clinical cancer research : CR
one_liner_zh: 该文研究circBPTF编码蛋白BPTF-665aa通过染色质重塑驱动T-LBL/ALL化疗耐药，涉及分子对接与动力学模拟，但核心是表观遗传调控与耐药机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，仅方法部分可借鉴。
abstract: Chemoresistance remains a major challenge in addressing T-cell lymphoblastic lymphoma/leukemia (T-LBL/ALL), underscoring the necessity for novel strategies to unravel the molecular factors driving resistance. Through transcriptomic profiling, circBPTF was found to be markedly overexpressed in chemoresistant samples. Further functional experiments demonstrated that BPTF-665aa, the protein product of circBPTF, plays a pivotal role in mediating resistance. Notably, BPTF-665aa prevents the ubiquitination degradation of full-length BPTF, and promotes chromatin accessibility at key promoter sites, such as that of c-Myc promter 2 (P2), facilitating transcriptional activation crucial for cellular survival and proliferation under therapeutic stress. Structural studies confirmed the motifs of BPTF-665aa, including the Plant Homeodomain (PHD) finger and Bromodomain, essential for its chromatin remodeling function. HY-B0509 was identified as a small-molecule inhibitor of BPTF-665aa, with molecular docking and dynamics simulations showing stable binding to critical residues within the protein's active site. Overall, this study introduces a new mechanism where circBPTF affects chromatin accessibility, causing chemoresistance, making BPTF-665aa as a potential therapeutic target for treating T-LBL/ALLs.
abstract_zh: 化疗耐药仍是T细胞淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤/白血病（T-LBL/ALL）治疗中的重大挑战，凸显了探索驱动耐药分子因素的新策略的必要性。通过转录组分析，发现circBPTF在化疗耐药样本中显著过表达。进一步的功能实验表明，circBFPF的蛋白产物BPTF-665aa在介导耐药中发挥关键作用。值得注意的是，BPTF-665aa阻止全长BPTF的泛素化降解，并促进关键启动子位点（如c-Myc启动子2（P2））的染色质可及性，从而在治疗应激下促进细胞存活和增殖所必需的转录激活。结构研究确认了BPTF-665aa的基序，包括植物同源结构域（PHD）指和溴结构域，这些对其染色质重塑功能至关重要。HY-B0509被鉴定为BPTF-665aa的小分子抑制剂，分子对接和动力学模拟显示其与蛋白活性位点内的关键残基稳定结合。总体而言，本研究提出了一种新机制，即circBPTF通过影响染色质可及性导致化疗耐药，使BPTF-665aa成为治疗T-LBL/ALL的潜在治疗靶点。
